name: catalog-card-consumers
goal: Catalog cards show at most three distinct consumers across module types while full usage remains on detail pages.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: All shared card footers list at most the first three distinct consumers in existing module order. Detail relationship lists retain every consumer and their existing pagination.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standardized grid matrix only enforces the helper-specific cap. Model assertions accept unlimited links, and component fixtures lack high fan-out. Extend shared footer unit cases and the existing grid matrix using mixed dense consumers.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At test commit 4c17b8a9b the unchanged standard grid matrix fails at desktop, tablet and mobile: model and component footers contain nine links against the three-consumer limit. Both shared-footer unit cases fail with six links instead of three.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Original repair 09251927e1fbbde823e0f1fd716a0688e37e4ae4 capped model footers. Main fbf03bbed now supplies the shared renderer and all dense/dedupe assertions; integration retains only SSR workload instrumentation and this historical loop.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Preserved immutable pair: red b97d1cf5ce3312c29dcfab3507da7c4e0b4cf315 record 2b33001414b2dfea847f598a4955a8247a3bcc1f9172e2c87672c86a8946bed2; green 09251927e1fbbde823e0f1fd716a0688e37e4ae4 record 0e138b033f044e6629a045016db60bfec26b3654ad6e203d4365c138243eb585. Integration is positive verification over already-correct main, not a new red/green pair.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Original red/green refs and proof remain preserved. Integration c6ca5d453 passed 208 component tests, 11 browser cases, 22 card/footer cases and captured 181 Git-backed images. Capture prerequisite #58 has landed at ff91d603c. Refresh on that main is pending focused verification. History device switching retains a desktop-specific state; coordinator assigned that aggregate gap to Fixing data. CLI/native suites remain deferred. Pages #52 owns the next conditional landing slot; this test-only supplement stays held behind it.
